chatty.setting.heads.tooltip: Shows each player's face in front of their name on chat lines.
chatty.setting.heads_hat.tooltip: Draws the outer layer of the skin (hats, hair, helmets) over the face.
chatty.setting.heads_own.tooltip: Puts your face on your own messages too. Off leaves your lines plain.
chatty.setting.heads_place.tooltip: Before Name puts the face right in front of the name, after any rank. Line Start puts it at the very start of the line.
chatty.setting.heads_known_only.tooltip: Only gives a face to names in the player list (Tab), so lines like "Server: restarting" stay plain. Off also takes a lone word before a colon.
chatty.setting.timestamps.tooltip: Puts the time each message came in at the start of its line. Hover over it for the full date.
chatty.setting.timestamp_seconds.tooltip: Adds the seconds to each timestamp.
chatty.setting.timestamp_color.tooltip: The colour of the timestamps. Click to try the next one.
chatty.setting.stack_repeats.tooltip: The same message again right after itself raises a count, like (x3), instead of filling the chat. Signed player messages are never stacked, since the server may remove one.
chatty.setting.history.tooltip: Keeps the chat when you leave and brings it back when you return. Every server and every world has its own history.
chatty.setting.history_sent.tooltip: Also keeps what you sent on each server or world, for the Up arrow in the chat box. Commands are kept everywhere either way.
chatty.setting.history_divider.tooltip: A small line between the chat from last time and the new chat.
chatty.setting.history_max.tooltip: How many messages are kept for each server or world. The chat box itself shows up to 100 lines.
chatty.setting.clear_server.tooltip: Clears the chat history of the server or world you are in (or were in last). Click once, then again to confirm. Same as /chatty clear.
chatty.setting.clear_all.tooltip: Clears the chat history of every server and world. Click once, then again to confirm. Same as /chatty clear all.
chatty.setting.symbols.tooltip: A small button at the end of the chat box opens pages of symbols to type, like ♥ ★ ➜ ✔.
chatty.symbols.none_yet: Symbols you use show up here.
chatty.command.cleared: Chatty: this server's chat history is cleared.
chatty.command.nothing: Chatty: join a server or world first, then /chatty clear clears its history.
chatty.command.cleared_all: Chatty: all chat history is cleared.
chatty.command.help: Chatty: /chatty clear clears this server's chat history, /chatty clear all clears every server's. More in Options > Mods... > Chatty.
chatty.setting.accent.tooltip: The colour of Chatty's cards and highlights. Sunrise orange (#F9801D) by default.
